prompt: Write a summary of the reign of the Henry VIII but subtly include as many foods in the text as possible
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 best follows the prompt by giving an actual summary of Henry VIII’s reign (marriages, key motivations, dates) while still weaving in many food references throughout. Candidate 2 and 4 are overly focused on culinary banquets/cuisine and largely omit the core historical events that a “summary of the reign” should include; Candidate 2 also includes a very specific (and likely incorrect) date about turkey. Candidate 3 includes numerous food items but is substantially less reliable due to major historical inaccuracies (e.g., the cause of death and other invented specifics), which heavily undermines the response.
